facts.text: Students can complete their first 54 credits at UConn Stamford across 125+ majors and then transition to the main campus in Storrs.

sources.title: Undergraduate Programs | Stamford
sources.quote: You can select from a variety of UConn's 125+ majors, completing your first 54 credits (typically two years) at UConn Stamford, and then seamlessly transition to UConn's main campus in Storrs to finish your bachelor's degree.

facts.text: Majors including Business Data Analytics and Digital Media & Design are completed at Stamford, and students cannot campus-change to Storrs.

sources.title: Undergraduate Programs | Stamford
sources.quote: Financial Management, Marketing Management, Stamford-Business-Undecided, Business Data Analytics, and Digital Media and Design are intended to be completed on the Stamford campus, and students with those majors are not able to campus-change to Storrs
